corinthians1.2.p1.b1.text: When I came to you, brothers, I did not come with eloquence or wisdom as I proclaimed to you the testimony about God.

corinthians1.2.p1.b2.text: For I resolved to know nothing while I was with you except Jesus Christ and Him crucified.

corinthians1.2.p1.b3.text: I came to you in weakness and fear, and with much trembling.

corinthians1.2.p2.b1.text: My message and my preaching were not with persuasive words of wisdom, but with a demonstration of the Spirit’s power,

corinthians1.2.p2.b2.text: so that your faith would not rest on men’s wisdom, but on God’s power.

corinthians1.2.p2.b3.text: None of the rulers of this age understood it. For if they had, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.

corinthians1.2.p3.b1.text: Rather, as it is written: “No eye has seen, no ear has heard, no heart has imagined, what God has prepared for those who love Him.”

corinthians1.2.p3.b2.text: But God has revealed it to us by the Spirit. The Spirit searches all things, …

corinthians1.2.p3.b3.text: We have not received the spirit of the world, but the Spirit who is from God, that we may understand what God has freely given us.

corinthians1.2.p4.b1.text: … in words taught by the Spirit, expressing spiritual truths in spiritual words.

corinthians1.2.p4.b2.text: The natural man does not accept the things that come from the Spirit of God. For they are foolishness to him, …

corinthians1.2.p4.b3.text: “For who has known the mind of the Lord, so as to instruct Him?” But we have the mind of Christ.
